system.name: Dobi-SVD
system.one_liner: A differentiable SVD paradigm for LLM compression: trainable truncation positions, optimal weight update by IPCA, and remapped storage.

content.variant_note: five numbered technique tiles of unequal size in one lilac frame, each a mini plot, formula or isometric block diagram; the order comes from the numbers and the caption, not from arrows
content.argues: Three coordinated parts (differentiable truncation training, optimal weight update, remapping) make SVD-based LLM compression adaptive and genuinely smaller.
content.subject: Five technique tiles of Dobi-SVD drawn as 3D singular-value stacks, gradient formulas, an optimisation landscape, an IPCA funnel and storage block equations.

elements.name: 1. Parameter Renormalization: From Discrete to Continuous
elements.role: turns the discrete rank-ratio choice into a continuous one (per the caption, for continuous rank ratio selection)
elements.drawn_as: two 3D stacks of per-layer singular-value curves over rank ratio (Layer0.Q to Layer1.Q) joined by a coral-red arrow; a red polyline links the chosen points on each

elements.name: 2. Robust Backpropagation
elements.role: keeps the SVD gradient stable when singular values are close
elements.drawn_as: two blue-headed sub-boxes: 'Singular Values of Activation' with a curve plot and sigma_i ~ sigma_j, and 'Compute the Gradient of the Loss Function' with two formulas

elements.name: Singular Values of Activation
elements.role: shows many singular-value curves collapsing so that neighbouring values are nearly equal
elements.drawn_as: plot of singular value against rank ratio with a dashed ellipse and a large blue 'sigma_i ~ sigma_j' call-out above the title SVD(XW_atten_k)

elements.name: Compute the Gradient of the Loss Function
elements.role: gradient dL/dM contains 1/(sigma_i - sigma_j) and explodes to NAN; the Taylor expansion replaces it with a finite sum
elements.drawn_as: formula on a pale-yellow arrow shape leading to a boxed bold NAN; a blue Taylor Expansion arrow down to the series formula, which leads to a small Loss against Epoch curve

elements.name: 3. Optimization Landscape of Model Compression
elements.role: shows the landscape over layers and training epochs between the original and the compressed model size
elements.drawn_as: large 3D surface with axes Compression Ratio, Rank Ratio, Singular Value and a grey 'Training Epoch' arrow; layer names Layer1 to Layer32 Linear.W; planes labelled Original Model Size and Compressed Model Size

elements.name: 4. Weight Update
elements.role: updates the weights sequentially from the truncated activations with IPCA
elements.drawn_as: tall narrow panel: yellow and purple cubes X_n and X_(n-1), a funnel holding A = XW, A_(n-2), A_(n-3), SVD(A) rows and IPCA, a drop, and a pastel slab W~

elements.name: IPCA funnel
elements.role: extracts features of the updated weights one input after another to save memory
elements.drawn_as: blue-rimmed funnel narrowing from A = XW through the SVD rows to the word IPCA

elements.name: W~
elements.drawn_as: isometric slab of pastel cells under the funnel

elements.name: 5. Remapping
elements.role: stores the SVD factors so that truncation position and compression ratio map one to one
elements.drawn_as: wide bottom band: a rank-ratio plot with Bijection and Injection tags, then three sub-diagrams on a pale-green caption strip

elements.name: Ours: Remapping / Traditional
elements.role: rank ratio against compression ratio: the straight remapped line versus the traditional piecewise line capped at max(m,n)/(m+n)
elements.drawn_as: plot with a thick dark-blue diagonal and a lighter diagonal, pink dashed bands at 1.0 and max(m,n)/(m+n), rotated bold labels

elements.name: Bijection / Injection
elements.role: bijection: every rank has its own size; injection: not every size is reachable
elements.drawn_as: two pairs of ovals with dots labelled Rank and Size joined by red arrows, the injection pair faded

elements.name: 1. Traditional Storage Method: k x (m + n)
elements.role: stores U-Sigma and V^T separately, which costs k x (m + n)
elements.drawn_as: isometric blocks U-Sigma (m x k) + V^T (k x n) = a product block with pink translucent planes, dimension braces m, k, n

elements.name: 2. Quantization-friendly
elements.role: the column values of U or V follow a bell-shaped distribution, suited to uniform quantization
elements.drawn_as: histogram titled Distribution(Col(U or V)) with Frequency and Value axes

elements.name: 3. Proposed Storage Method: k x m, m >= n
elements.role: packs the factors into one k x m block with mixed bit widths so storage depends only on the truncation position
elements.drawn_as: isometric stacked blocks coloured by bit width equal to a single block, with a legend 16-bit light blue, 8-bit dark blue, 0-bit pink

lessons.what_to_learn: Give each technique its own numbered tile with the picture that best explains it (a 3D plot, a formula that explodes then is fixed, a funnel, isometric blocks), and let the tinted frame, numbers and caption carry the order instead of arrows.
lessons.suits: method papers with several loosely coupled technical parts, each explained best by a different kind of mini picture.

evidence: using Taylor expansion to prevent gradient explosion
we derive the theoretical optimal weight update formula and employ Incremental Principal Component Analysis (IPCA)
This method establishes a bijection mapping between the truncation position and the model compression ratio

summary: Dobi-SVD is a paradigm for SVD-based LLM compression with differentiable truncation, an optimal weight update and a remapping of storage. Figure 1 is a mosaic of five numbered tiles in a lilac frame: (1) per-layer singular-value stacks before and after renormalising the rank ratio from discrete to continuous, (2) robust backpropagation, a gradient formula that explodes to NAN and its Taylor-expanded fix, (3) a 3D optimisation landscape between original and compressed model size, (4) a funnel for the IPCA weight update, and (5) remapping, with a bijection versus injection picture, a rank-ratio line plot and isometric block equations for traditional versus proposed storage. No arrows join the tiles; numbers and the caption give the order.
summary_zh: Dobi-SVD 用可微分截断、最优权重更新和重映射做 SVD 大模型压缩。图1是紫色边框里五个编号小块的拼贴：3D 奇异值堆叠、泰勒展开修复 NaN 的反向传播、优化地形、IPCA 漏斗权重更新、重映射存储对比。
notes: Prior kinds kept (contribution-mosaic first) with side-by-side-contrast added for tiles 1, 2 and 5; the figure also has a numbered order (caption: steps 1-3, 4, 5), hence stage-pipeline. The 3D plots look measured but may be schematic, so they are typed chart or schematic-plot by appearance. The funnel's drop below IPCA is unlabelled. The pale-yellow arrow backgrounds and pink 0-bit colour are bitmap colours without a digest hex, so they are not in the palette. The schema has no marker kind for NAN, recorded as other.
